services.name: Horse Boarding
services.desc: We understand how important it is that your horse be well taken care of. We strive to do as good a job every day as you would yourself. Our friendly staff will do everything they can to ensure your horses safety and comfort. Isn't it nice knowing your horse is taken care of even when you can't be there yourself? We pride ourselves on not only loving our work, but loving the horses we work with. Our boarding services give you the comfort of knowing your horse is in good hands at all times. Your horse will enjoy our spacious 12'x12' box stalls which are cleaned daily. Every stall has a window, dutch door and crossties. Top quality horse feed.
